answer: Each dawn, a new identity must lock 80 tokens for 24 epochs and pass 4 weekly audit rounds before earning. One identity therefore risks 80 tokens over that horizon; ten sybils lock 800, and because rewards per identity are capped at 12 tokens per epoch, extra copies add cost linearly while profit cannot scale the same way. The registry verifies the thread of on-ledger lock receipts and signed audit responses, slashing 30% if an identity misses two audits or unlocks early.
